sample_unit: LLM responses (22 questions x 5 public chatbot interfaces)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses versus recommended sixth-grade reading level
links.effect: No evaluated response set achieved sixth-grade readability and no individual response met all six readability thresholds; best interface (DeepSeek-v4) mean FKGL still 11.53.
links.quote: No evaluated public-interface response set achieved recommended sixth-grade readability, and no individual response met all six readability thresholds.

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of LLM patient information responses
links.effect: No response set met sixth-grade readability; even the most favorable profile (DeepSeek-v4) had mean FKGL of 11.53.
links.quote: Responses returned by the interface displaying the label 'DeepSeek-v4' had the most favorable observed readability profile within this sampled response set, although the mean FKGL remained 11.53.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the quality, readability, guideline concordance, and clinical risk signals of default first responses from five publicly accessible LLM chatbot interfaces answering patient questions without testing any specific guardrail or deployment practice.
